metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Bootstrap (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Substrate • Measures • RTT • Regimes • Lineage
metadata.description: Defines the canonical bootstrap sequence for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Bootstrap MUST verify substrate, initialize measures, seed lineage, and enter RTT1 under nominal regime.

rules: Substrate MUST be declared before any RTT transition.
Non-agentic substrates MUST NOT escalate harmonically.
All measures MUST initialize in [0.80, 0.95] for nominal entry.

initialize_session_state.notes: Session begins with no paradox and no consent.

rules: RTT1 MUST be the initial node.
RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.

enter_nominal_regime.notes: Nominal regime corresponds to frozen RTT diffusion → alignment → coupling → activation → triadic time → S–N–R.

declare_coherence.notes: Coherence MUST be declared before any regime transition.

bound_drift.notes: Drift MUST remain bounded for resonance-time stability.

rules: Typed paradox required for RTT7 entry.
Consent conflicts MUST be logged as paradox.consent_conflict.
Projections MUST NOT contradict authoritative files.

non_claims: Bootstrap does not revise RTT v0.9.
Bootstrap does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Bootstrap does not replace the human FFT book.
